Kerlam ka 70 sal purana vikas modal aarthik tarakki ke sath-sath shiksha, svasthy, samajik samanta aur loktantr ko bhi prathmikta deta hai. nisim mannathukuren batate hain ki kaise kerlam ka modal bharat ke vikas ke maujuda najrie ko ek alag vikalp aur aaeena dikhata hai.
